title: Netflix Artwork Personalization via LLM Post-training
abstract: arXiv:2601.02764v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated success in various applications of user recommendation and personalization across e-commerce and entertainment. On many entertainment platforms such as Netflix, users typically interact with a wide range of titles, each represented by an artwork. Since users have diverse preferences, an artwork that appeals to one type of user may not resonate with another with different preferences. Given this user heterogeneity, our work explores the novel problem of personalized artwork recommendations according to diverse user preferences. Similar to the multi-dimensional nature of users' tastes, titles contain different themes and tones that may appeal to different viewers. For example, the same title might feature both heartfelt family drama and intense action scenes. translated_title: 通过LLM后训练实现Netflix艺术作品个性化
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLMs）已在电子商务和娱乐领域的各种用户推荐和个性化应用中展现出成功。在Netflix等许多娱乐平台上，用户通常会与各种标题互动，每个标题由一件艺术作品表示。由于用户偏好多样，吸引一类用户的作品可能无法引起另一类具有不同偏好的用户的共鸣。鉴于这种用户异质性，我们的工作探索了根据多样化用户偏好进行个性化艺术作品推荐的新问题。类似于用户品味的多维性，标题包含不同的主题和基调，可能吸引不同的观众。例如，同一标题可能既有温馨的家庭剧情，也有紧张的动作场景。偏好浪漫内容的用户可能喜欢强调角色间情感温暖的作品，而偏好动作的用户则可能更喜欢突出紧张刺激场景的作品。
tldr: 本文提出利用大型语言模型的后训练方法，针对Netflix平台上的艺术作品进行个性化推荐，以匹配用户多样化的偏好。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes using post-training of large language models to personalize artwork recommendations on Netflix, catering to diverse user preferences.
